claims.claim: Yellowstone wolves participate in social and food relationships.

claims.evidence: Wolves are highly social animals and live in packs. … Many other animals benefit from wolf kills.
claims.narrative: Yellowstonewolven zijn sociale roofdieren: ze jagen in groepen en hun prooien voeden ook andere dieren.
claims.explanation: The title concisely frames the social and feeding relationships described in the source.
claims.materiality: This framing is central to the piece and is supported.

claims.claim: Yellowstone wolves live in social family groups.

claims.excerpt: Ze jagen samen en zorgen voor hun jongen.
claims.claim: Yellowstone wolves hunt together and care for their young.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Research in Yellowstone since reintroduction has highlighted the adaptive value of social living in wolves – from cooperative care of offspring, group hunting of large prey
claims.narrative: Introduce Yellowstonewolven als sociale familiegroepen, met onder meer gezamenlijke jacht en zorg voor jongen.

claims.excerpt: Wanneer wolven een prooi doden, wordt die ook voedsel voor andere dieren: van raven en coyotes tot beren en ongewervelden.
claims.claim: Animals including ravens, coyotes, bears, and invertebrates consume remains of wolf kills.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Many other animals benefit from wolf kills. … Many other animals—from eagles to invertebrates—consume the remains.
claims.narrative: Laat zien dat een wolvendoding voedsel biedt aan dieren van raven en coyotes tot beren en ongewervelden.
claims.explanation: The listed animals are supported by the source, which describes ravens, coyotes, bears, and invertebrates consuming or benefiting from wolf-kill remains.
claims.materiality: Accurately conveys the food relationship without claiming all animals feed in the same way.

claims.excerpt: De prooien waarop wolven jagen, veranderen eveneens.
claims.claim: The prey composition or selection of Yellowstone wolves has changed over time.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: From 1995 to 2000, in early winter, elk calves comprised 50% of wolf prey, and bull elk comprised 25%. That ratio reversed from 2001 to 2007
claims.narrative: De veranderde samenstelling van hun prooi in verschillende perioden maakt concreet dat predatiepatronen veranderen binnen omstandigheden waarin meerdere factoren meespelen.
claims.explanation: The source documents a change in early-winter prey composition between the two periods and also describes bison as an increasingly important food source.
claims.materiality: A supported summary of the documented changes.

claims.excerpt: Onder de vroege-winterprooien verschilde de verhouding tussen elandkalveren en volwassen mannelijke elanden in 1995–2000 en 2001–2007.
claims.claim: The ratio of elk calves to adult male elk among early-winter wolf prey differed between 1995–2000 and 2001–2007.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: From 1995 to 2000, in early winter, elk calves comprised 50% of wolf prey, and bull elk comprised 25%. That ratio reversed from 2001 to 2007
claims.narrative: Gebruik daarnaast de verschuiving in de verhouding tussen elandkalveren en volwassen mannelijke elanden onder de vroege-winterprooien in 1995–2000 en 2001–2007 als concreet voorbeeld van veranderende prooisamenstelling
claims.explanation: The Dutch accurately identifies the prey categories, early-winter context, and periods. It says the ratio differed, without misstating the source's more specific finding that it reversed.
claims.materiality: The ratio shift is the piece's concrete example of changing prey composition.

claims.excerpt: Die verschuiving hangt samen met de beschikbaarheid en kwetsbaarheid van prooien.
claims.claim: The shift is associated with prey availability and vulnerability.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: That ratio reversed from 2001 to 2007, indicating changes in prey vulnerability and availability.
claims.narrative: de bron verbindt die veranderingen met de beschikbaarheid en kwetsbaarheid van prooien.
claims.explanation: The source says the ratio reversal indicated changes in vulnerability and availability; the piece's wording does not assign the shift to one exclusive cause.

claims.excerpt: Veranderingen in predatie en de effecten daarvan op elanden vallen samen met andere factoren, waaronder andere roofdieren, het beheer van hoefdieren buiten het park en het weer.
claims.claim: Changes in wolf predation and their effects on elk are associated with other predators, ungulate management outside the park, and weather.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Changes in wolf predation patterns and impacts on prey species like elk are inextricably linked to other factors, such as other predators, management of ungulates outside the park, and weather
claims.narrative: veranderingen in predatie en de effecten op elanden samenvallen met andere factoren, waaronder andere roofdieren, beheer van hoefdieren buiten het park en het weer.
claims.explanation: The listed factors and their relationship to changing predation and elk impacts match the source. “Vallen samen” is no stronger than the source's description of linked factors and complex interactions.
claims.materiality: Accurately communicates that multiple factors are involved, without assigning their relative contributions.

claims.excerpt: De wolven maken deel uit van een samenspel van sociale en voedselrelaties; ze zijn niet de enige bepalende kracht.
claims.claim: Wolves are part of interacting social and food relationships and are not the sole determinant of ecosystem or elk outcomes.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Consequently, changes in prey selection and kill rates through time result from complex interactions among these factors.
claims.narrative: Zo blijft het verhaal bij een complex samenspel, niet bij wolven als enige bepalende kracht.
claims.explanation: The source attributes changing prey selection and kill rates to complex interactions among several factors. The piece does not claim that wolves have no effect, only that they are not the sole determining force.
claims.materiality: This qualification prevents a misleading single-cause interpretation.
